entries.title: Talk to Atlarix while it is working
entries.body: A message you type mid-turn now reaches the turn that is running, instead of waiting for it to end. Type as many as you like — each one is cancellable until it is picked up.

entries.title: Atlarix Core 1 is now GLM 5.3
entries.body: Core 1 moved to GLM 5.3 — same 1M context, same price, and deep thinking scales to what the model supports. Nothing to install; it is already live.

entries.title: Your plan updates when you come back
entries.body: Upgrading happens in a browser, so Atlarix now re-checks your plan every time you return to the window instead of only after it had been idle.

entries.title: A usage bar that reads as a percentage
entries.body: Settings shows how much of this month's included usage you have spent, and leads with the credit you bought. Your account page now separates Atlarix from Atlarix Reviewer.
